properties.name: maxQueueTime
properties.description: 最大排队时间 【Swagger】This is not implemented in the current version of InSite. This value determines the maximum length of time a Container can remain in an in-queue state at the Step that uses this Spec. The value for MaximumQueueTimeAction determines the action to take if the in-queue time exceeds this value.

properties.name: maxQueueTimeAction
properties.description: 超时动作：0=None, 1=Warn, 3=Hold, 4=Block 【Swagger】This is not implemented in the current version of InSite. This value is used to determine the action to take when a Service (transaction) is started for a Container that has been in-queue longer than the allowable queue time (MaxQueueTime). The values for this option are: 0 = No action 1 = Warning to Operator 2 = Warning to Operator requiring a password to continue 3 = Place container on Hold 4 = Do not allow transaction to continue These values and their associated actions are intended to match the values and actions for field validations. This action applies to any service that changes a Container from an In-Queue to an In-Process state.

properties.name: warningQueueTime
properties.description: 容器排队状态触发警告前的时长（当前版本未实现）。 【Swagger】This is not implemented in the current version of InSite. This value specifies the length of time a Container can remain in an in-queue state before a warning is to be triggered.

properties.description: 单单位加工时长 【Swagger】This value specifies the amount of time needed to process a single unit. This is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

properties.name: yield
properties.description: 预期良率 (%) 【Swagger】Specifies the standard yield expected for processing with this Spec. This value is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

properties.name: spec
properties.description: 关联的母规格定义 → Spec

properties.name: fastCycleTime
properties.description: 物理字段 FastCycleTime 【Swagger】This is a calculated value that denotes the time required processing a standard size batch of material using this Spec, assuming fast queue time. This is used to determine, for example, how quickly a job can be expedited through the Factory. The calculation for this value uses attributes of other CDOs. This means that changing a Work Center value, for example, can effect this value. This means that this value should be calculated each time that it is needed. The value that is persisted will only be valid as of the point in time that this Spec was saved.

properties.name: normalCycleTime
properties.description: 物理字段 NormalCycleTime 【Swagger】This is a calculated value that denotes the time required processing a standard size batch of material using this Spec, assuming normal queue time. The calculation for this value uses attributes of other CDOs. This means that changing a Work Center value, for example, can effect this value. This means that this value should be calculated each time that it is needed. The value that is persisted will only be valid as of the point in time that this Spec was saved.

properties.name: runRateOption
properties.description: 物理字段 RunRateOption 【Swagger】This option determines if run rate is specified as hours per unit or units per hour or time per batch. The values and their meanings are: 1 = Hours per unit (RunRateTime) 2 = Unites per hour (RunRateQuantity) 3 = Time Per Batch (RunRate Time)

properties.name: unitsPerHour
properties.description: 每小时产出单位数 (UPH) 【Swagger】This value specifies the number of units processed in an hour. This is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

properties.name: stdBatchSize
properties.description: 标准批次大小 【Swagger】This value specifies the standard size of a batch of material processed using this Spec. This is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

properties.name: setupTime
properties.description: 设置/换线时长 【Swagger】This value specifies the time required for a Setup at this Operation. This is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

properties.name: unscheduledTime
properties.description: 物理字段 UnscheduledTime 【Swagger】Process time that is not contained in the UPH,HPU or Batch Time entries.

properties.name: timePerBatch
properties.description: 物理字段 TimePerBatch 【Swagger】This value specified the time needed to process a single Batch.
